subject: Science
competency_statement: Balance chemical equations and predict reaction mechanisms (combination, decomposition, displacement, double displacement, redox).
mandatory_practical: Performing and observing action of water on quicklime, action of heat on ferrous sulphate, and iron nails in copper sulphate solution.
source_citation: CBSE Secondary Curriculum 2025–26, Science (Code 086); NCERT Class 10 Chapter 1

subject: Science
competency_statement: Apply Ohm's law, compute equivalent resistance, and analyze Joule's heating and domestic electric safety circuits.
mandatory_practical: Studying the dependence of potential difference across a resistor on current and determining its resistance.
source_citation: CBSE Secondary Curriculum 2025–26, Science (Code 086); NCERT Class 10 Chapter 11

subject: Mathematics Standard
competency_statement: Formulate quadratic models from real-world situations, solve via quadratic formula, and classify root nature using discriminant.
mandatory_practical: Classroom activity on visual verification of quadratic factorization using paper grid algebra tiles.
source_citation: CBSE Secondary Curriculum 2025–26, Mathematics (Code 041); NCERT Class 10 Chapter 4
